```
['create an OvmmSimClient instance with a HabitatOpenVocabManipEnv and stretch robot flag', 'navigate the simulated robot to a target xyt position in global or relative coordinates', 'execute a multi-step trajectory by looping navigate_to calls for each waypoint', 'switch the simulated robot between navigation mode and manipulation mode', 'grasp an object in simulation by snapping it to the robot end effector']
```

